requirements.text: For a retro-reflector not marked "TOP", the RI at the other angles of illumination and divergence shall meet the paragraph 5 values with the device in the minimum-RI rotation position ε; if the values are not attained there, they may be met with the device rotated about its axis of reference within ±5° of that position.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at all prescribed illumination and divergence angles at the minimum-RI ε position, re-measuring within ±5° of it if needed, and compare with the paragraph 5 values.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector is marked "TOP", its RI shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position during rotation of ±5° about its axis, at an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° (or the specified angle) and an angle of divergence of 20'.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked retro-reflector ±5° about its reference axis at β = 0°, α = 20' and confirm RI stays at or above the limit throughout.

requirements.text: If a mirror effect is produced at an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0°, the RI requirement for that direction shall be met with the reading taken at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Turn the device slightly about β = 0° to check for a specular peak; if present, measure RI at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° and compare with the limit.

requirements.text: If the RI at β1 = β2 = 0° and ε = 0° exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, the retro-reflector shall meet the RI values at all angles of illumination and divergence with ε = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at β = 0°, ε = 0°; if it is at least 1.5 times the limit, measure all other angles at ε = 0° and check compliance.

requirements.text: The retro-reflection performance (RI) of the retro-reflector shall be met when it is illuminated with CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Annex 4, Part 1.
requirements.test_case: Perform the goniophotometric RI measurement with a source calibrated to CIE Illuminant A (2856 K) and verify the RI values.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the Class IA or IB retro-reflector shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape prescribed for trailer retro-reflectors, when observed from a distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector's illuminating surface from 10 m and confirm it cannot be mistaken for a triangle.

requirements.text: The moulded plastics retro-reflector (Class IA or IB) shall withstand being kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, followed by cooling for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Condition the retro-reflector sample in a dry oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 h, then cool for 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C, before the post-test inspection.

requirements.text: After the heat resistance test, no cracking of the retro-reflective device, in particular of its optical component, shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the conditioned retro-reflector and its prism optics for cracks.

requirements.text: After the heat resistance test, no appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device, in particular of its optical component, shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the conditioned retro-reflector and its optical unit for warping or distortion.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector (whether part of a lamp or not), stripped of all removable parts, shall withstand immersion for 10 minutes in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface, and a repeat immersion after turning the device through 180° so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the stripped retro-reflector or lamp for 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water, 20 mm below the surface, in both orientations.

requirements.text: After the 50 °C immersions, the retro-reflector shall withstand immediate immersion under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Transfer the sample immediately to 25 °C ± 5 °C water under the same immersion conditions.

requirements.text: After the immersion test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device fails the test.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reflecting surface of the prism optics for water after the immersion sequence.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal water, or in case of doubt, the RI of the retro-reflector, after lightly shaking off excess water from the outside, shall be measured by the method of paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 of the Regulation and shall comply with the requirements of that paragraph.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 after shaking off water and compare with the prescribed values.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB (lamp not watertight) and the manufacturer choosing the moisture and dust test alternative, the retro-reflector, mounted with initial RI recorded, shall withstand a solid-cone water spray directed downward at 45° ± 5° to the vertical, with a precipitation rate at the device of 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min, while rotating about its vertical axis at 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
requirements.test_case: Expose the lamp in a water spray cabinet at 2.5 mm/min with 45° nozzle on a platform rotating at 4 min-1 and record the conditions.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture and dust test alternative, the water spray exposure of the retro-reflector shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Run the water spray for 12 cycles of 60 min and log the duration.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture and dust test alternative, the lamp containing the retro-reflector shall pass the water spray test with all drain holes and other openings open, and with any drain wicks fitted in the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that all drain holes and openings are unobstructed and drain wicks are installed before the spray test.

requirements.text: Since the retro-reflector is grouped or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions, those functions shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray test according to a cycle of 5 min ON and 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Power the lamp functions at design voltage with a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF timer during the spray exposure and record the cycle.

requirements.text: After the 12-hour water spray and a 1-hour drain period with the cabinet door closed, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, nor be formable by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: After the drain period, visually inspect the lamp interior, tap and tilt the device and check for any standing pool of water.

requirements.text: After the moisture test and drying of the exterior, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured according to Part 1 of Annex 4 to verify its photometric performance after moisture exposure.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1 after the test and compare with initial values and the prescribed RI limits.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture and dust test alternative, the retro-reflector shall withstand exposure to test dust of fine powdered cement in accordance with ASTM C 150-84, in a chamber of max. 2 m3 charged with 3 to 5 kg of dust.
requirements.test_case: Verify the dust certificate (ASTM C 150-84 cement) and the chamber charge before the dust exposure.

requirements.text: In case of Class IB with the moisture and dust test alternative, the mounted device, with drain holes and openings open, shall withstand dust agitated by compressed air or blowers at intervals of 15 min for 2 to 15 s over a duration of 5 hours, with the dust settling between agitation periods.
requirements.test_case: Run the dust chamber agitation cycle for 5 hours with the lamp at least 150 mm from the walls and log the cycle.

requirements.text: After the dust exposure test, with the exterior cleaned and dried, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 to verify that dust penetration has not significantly affected its photometric output.
requirements.test_case: Clean the exterior with a dry cotton cloth, measure RI per 5.1.3.2.2 and compare with the initial and prescribed values.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Measure the CIL and chromaticity of the retro-reflector before and after the saline mist test per ISO 9227:2017 and compare them with the prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The front surface of the retro-reflector shall resist tarnishing and the protection of its rear face shall resist deterioration, particularly where an essential metal component is liable to be attacked, when tested for corrosion according to ISO 9227:2017.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the front surface and the rear-face protection visually after the ISO 9227:2017 salt spray exposure.

requirements.text: The rear lamp incorporating the retro-reflector, stripped of all removable parts, shall withstand a saline mist for 50 hours. The exposure consists of two 24-hour periods separated by a 2-hour interval during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Expose the stripped lamp in a salt spray chamber for 2 × 24 h with a 2 h drying interval, then evaluate it.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion (e.g. metallised mirror-backed prisms), the saline mist shall be produced by atomising, at 35 °C ± 2 °C, a solution of 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Record the chamber temperature and the NaCl solution concentration and purity during the salt spray test of the lamp.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the retro-reflector sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the sample visually for corrosion immediately after the salt spray test.

requirements.text: After a 48-hour recovery period following the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas shall be not less than the value in Table 9 and not more than the value in Table 10. RA is measured as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle β2 = 5° and an observation angle α = 20', after salt deposits have been removed.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery and removal of salt deposits, measure the retro-reflection at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and compare it with the Table 9 and Table 10 limits.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector is mirror-backed with an accessible rear face, the moulded plastics rear face (Class IA/IB) shall withstand, after being brushed with a hard nylon brush, the application for one minute of a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of Annex 7 Part 1 (70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol).
requirements.test_case: Brush the rear face with a hard nylon brush, apply a cloth soaked in 70/30 n-heptane/toluol for 1 min, let it dry, brush again, then inspect.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector is mirror-backed with an accessible rear face, after the rear-face resistance test the coefficient of luminous intensity (CIL/RI), measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 with the whole mirror-backed rear face covered with Indian ink, shall still meet the photometric requirements for Class IA/IB.
requirements.test_case: Cover the whole mirror-backed rear face with Indian ink, measure the CIL at the prescribed angles and compare it with the Class IA/IB limits.

requirements.text: When the accelerated artificial weathering test is applied, the retro-reflective device samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013, using the parameters of Table A6-1, for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Expose retro-reflector samples in a xenon-arc weathering apparatus per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 for 500 h, then perform the post-exposure photometric and colorimetric checks required by the Regulation.

requirements.text: The accelerated weathering exposure parameters shall be, in repeated cycles of 102 min dry followed by 18 min water spray: broadband irradiance (300 to 400 nm) 60 ± 2 W/m²; narrowband irradiance (340 nm) 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m²; relative humidity 50 ± 10 %. The temperature shall be either a black-standard temperature of 65 ± 3 °C (TM1, cycle No. 1 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013) or a black-panel temperature of 63 ± 3 °C (TM2, cycle No. 4 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013).
requirements.test_case: Check the weathering apparatus log for irradiance, temperature, humidity and the dry/spray cycle timing against the Table A6-1 values throughout the 500 h exposure.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device, in particular its illuminating surface, shall withstand exposure to a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol, applied by light wiping with a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the outer and illuminating surface of a sample with a cotton cloth soaked in 70/30 vol.% n-heptane/toluol, then perform the inspection.

requirements.text: About five minutes after being wiped with the n-heptane/toluol test mixture, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are not objected to.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the wiped surface about five minutes after application and confirm there are no apparent surface changes other than slight surface cracks.

requirements.text: For the moulded plastics Class IA or IB retro-reflector, after the outer surface (in particular the illuminating surface) has been lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil, left for about 5 minutes and then cleaned, the coefficient of luminous intensity (CIL/RI) measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 of this Regulation shall still meet the requirements of that paragraph.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the retro-reflector's illuminating surface with detergent lubricating oil, clean it after 5 minutes, then measure the CIL goniometrically per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 and compare it with the limits.

requirements.text: The approval number on the retro-reflector approval mark must be placed close to the circle surrounding the letter "E", in any position in relation to it.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector or lamp and confirm the approval number is adjacent to the E-circle.

requirements.text: The digits making up the approval number must face the same way as the letter "E" in the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm the orientation of the approval-number digits matches the orientation of the "E".

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class (IA or IB) must be placed diametrically opposite the approval number in relation to the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm the class symbol IA or IB sits on the opposite side of the E-circle from the approval number.

requirements.text: The exposed external surface of the rear lamp (outer lens and any visible housing rim/bezel or seal), as installed on the M1 vehicle, shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts.
requirements.test_case: Visually and manually inspect the installed lamp's exposed surfaces for outward-directed points or sharp edges.

requirements.text: The exposed external surface of the rear lamp shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any projections whose shape, dimensions, direction or hardness are likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in a collision.
requirements.test_case: Assess the projections of the installed lamp for shape, dimensions, direction and hardness, with projection dimensions measured per Annex 3.

requirements.text: The exposed external surface of the rear lamp shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and its interface with the surrounding body panel for hooks, open gaps or edges that could catch on clothing or a body.

requirements.text: In case the lamp outer surface (lens, housing rim/bezel or exposed seal) protrudes 5 mm or more beyond the body panel nominal line, no protruding part of the lamp shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, unless the material hardness exemption of para 5.5 applies.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp projection per Annex 3 para 2, and measure the edge radii of the exposed lens and housing with radius gauges or a 3D scan to confirm each is at least 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: In case a part of the lamp's external surface protrudes at least 1.5 mm but less than 5 mm, the outward-facing angles of that part shall be blunted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the protrusion per Annex 3 and inspect the outward-facing corners of the lens and bezel to confirm they are blunted (no sharp edge).

requirements.text: In case a protruding part of the lamp's external surface (e.g. an exposed TPE/silicone seal) has a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, that part shall be made of a material with a hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A, measured with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the Shore A hardness of the protruding part on the installed lamp (or use a comparable method where Shore A is not possible) and confirm it is at most 60 Shore A.

requirements.text: Vehicles approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved; series-production rear lamps fitted to the vehicle shall therefore continue to meet the external-projection requirements of paragraphs 5 and 6 (no pointed or sharp parts, minimum radii of curvature, hardness provisions).
requirements.test_case: Take series-production lamps fitted to vehicles and check edge radii, projections and hardness of exposed parts against paragraph 5 using the Annex 3 methods.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall be so fitted that, under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by UN R48 and enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Run a vehicle-level vibration or durability test, then re-check the installed lamp's position, orientation and photometry.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounting design (fixed locating features, no free adjusters) and check the lamp orientation after vibration.

requirements.text: The reference axis of each light-signalling function of the lamp, when fitted to the vehicle, shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed reference-axis angle relative to the ground plane on the vehicle and check it is within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of each light-signalling function of the lamp, when fitted to the vehicle, shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed reference-axis yaw angle relative to the vehicle centreline and check it is within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific fitting instructions laid down by the lamp manufacturer shall be complied with when the lamp is installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Compare the vehicle installation against the lamp manufacturer's fitting instructions.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the left and right rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral positions of the exterior contours of the left and right lamps relative to the vehicle centreline.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the left and right lamps of a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this does not apply to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the exterior geometry of the left and right lamps (CAD mirror check).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the left and right lamps of a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of each function on the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the left and right lamps of a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.test_case: Compare goniophotometer measurements of each function on the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: In case the lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo may be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear for the number and position of logos in lamps.

requirements.text: In case the lamp incorporates a logo, the logo shall be a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo; all other logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the logo artwork against the vehicle or body manufacturer's identity.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated only provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other applicable requirements are fulfilled for each function.
requirements.test_case: Verify colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and wiring for each function of the installed combination lamp.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of each function of the lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which it is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure the photometry and colour of each function with all other functions switched off.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp (or another function that can be switched ON together with it), the colour requirements of the stop lamp (or other function) shall be fulfilled when that function and the rear position lamp are switched ON together.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity with the rear position and stop functions energised simultaneously.

requirements.text: In case a function of the lamp is a single lamp whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, either the total projected area of the distinct parts in the direction of the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing that projection, or the minimum distance between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts shall not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicularly to the reference axis (not applicable to a single retro-reflector).
requirements.test_case: Project the apparent surface along the reference axis in CAD and calculate the area ratio or the edge gap.

requirements.text: In case a function is provided by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", either the projection of the apparent surfaces of the two lamps in the direction of the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces shall not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected apparent surfaces of both 'D' lamps on the vehicle and check the 60 % or 75 mm criterion.

requirements.text: In case a function is provided by an interdependent lamp system marked "Y", the system shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1 (60 per cent coverage or 75 mm maximum gap).
requirements.test_case: Check the projected apparent surfaces of the 'Y' lamps against the 60 % or 75 mm criterion.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of each lamp function shall not be intentionally varied while the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Monitor the intensity and colour of each function over time while it is switched ON.

requirements.text: Any variation of the photometric characteristics of a function in relation to ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp provides another function, shall comply with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensities in each operating state and compare them with the R148 limits.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear combination lamp shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility from the front zone of the vehicle per Annex 4.

requirements.text: There shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the red functions of the lamp when viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle (Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Perform a sightline or CAD check from Zone 1 at 25 m ahead of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the luminous intensity of red light emitted by the lamp towards the front shall not exceed 0.25 cd per lamp, taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure the forward red intensity of the lamp, including body shading, and check it is ≤ 0.25 cd.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, end-outline and side-marker lamps (if any) and the rear registration plate lamp, except in the cases of paragraph 5.11.1.
requirements.test_case: Operate the vehicle light switch and verify that the rear position lamps are switched together with the other listed lamps.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the system shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Energise the function and verify that all interdependent lamps switch together.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be concealable.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation for absence of any concealment device in front of the lamp.

requirements.text: Colours of light: reversing lamp white; stop lamp red; rear position lamp red; rear retro-reflector, non-triangular red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of each function and check them against the white or red boundaries of para 2.11.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate), at all fixed positions of the movable component it shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check position, visibility, colour and photometry with the tailgate in each fixed position.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp on a movable component is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", at least one of the lamps shall meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Verify one 'D' lamp in all fixed tailgate positions.

requirements.text: In case additional rear position lamps or retro-reflectors are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: With the tailgate open, measure the additional lamps' position, visibility and photometry.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is installed on a movable component, the lamp shall not cause undue discomfort to road users when the movable component is in a position other than the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Assess the light directions with the movable component open.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is installed on a movable component, the lamp shall always return to the position specified by the manufacturer when the movable component is in its normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Cycle the tailgate and measure the lamp position and orientation after each closing.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp and the rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component in any fixed position other than the normal position of use, unless paragraph 5.21.1 or 5.21.2 is applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the hidden fraction of the apparent surface in each fixed open position of movable components.

requirements.text: If more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface of the rear position lamp is hidden by a movable component, additional lamps satisfying all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements shall be switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Open the movable component and verify activation and compliance of the additional lamps.

requirements.text: Each light-signalling function of the lamp shall be capable of being made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or fuse; otherwise it is deemed not to be present.
requirements.test_case: Verify that each function lights when the lamp is installed and powered via its normal circuit.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2) have variable luminous intensity control, the intensity of all combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated such lamps shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensities of both functions across the control range and compare their proportional variation.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, the prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the stop lamp and rear position lamp shall be maintained over the entire intensity range, including during variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Log the intensities of both functions during transitions and calculate their ratio.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, increases and decreases of luminous intensity in relation to environmental conditions (ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds, contamination of the light emitting surface) shall remain within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
requirements.test_case: Measure the minimum and maximum intensities in each control state against the R148 limits.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, a traffic-condition intensity decrease shall only be activated when the vehicle speed is ≤ 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is ≤ 20 m, and may remain active only while the speed is ≤ 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle test: verify the activation and deactivation thresholds of the dimming against speed and following distance.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record the intensity over time during transitions and check for gradual change.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamp or rear position lamp has been tested with a special power supply, in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, the voltage supplied at its terminals on the vehicle shall not exceed the voltage specified for the device as approved; this does not apply if the device includes electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage on the vehicle in constant-voltage operating condition.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamp or rear position lamp does not include electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the voltage at its terminals shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 V system), 13.5 V (12 V system) or 28 V (24 V system) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage at the lamp connector with the vehicle electrical system in constant-voltage condition.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle inside the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of each lamp function observed from infinity, except obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Perform a CAD sightline analysis of the installed lamp across its visibility angles.

requirements.text: If any part of the apparent surface of the installed lamp is hidden by further parts of the vehicle, the unhidden part of the lamp shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Measure the photometry with the vehicle-body masking applied to the lamp.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is mounted less than 750 mm above the ground (measured from the H plane) and the vertical visibility angle below the horizontal is reduced to 5°, the photometric field of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the H-plane height and check the photometry down to 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Verify the geometric visibility with all 'Y' lamps lit.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions shall be type approved according to UN Regulation No. 148, and the rear retro-reflector according to UN Regulation No. 150, when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check for valid R148 and R150 approval markings on the lamp.

requirements.text: In case the lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R148 approval documentation covers the logo.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that a valid R148 (or R23) approval mark for the reversing lamp function is on the lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be installed not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the reversing lamp apparent surface above ground on the vehicle according to para 5.8.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp installed at the rear shall provide geometric visibility over α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° to the right and to the left if only one device is fitted, or 45° outwards and 30° inwards if two devices are fitted.
requirements.test_case: Verify the unobstructed view of the apparent surface over the specified angles on the vehicle or with a vehicle-installation mock-up.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check that the reference axis of the reversing lamp points rearwards when installed.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that it can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and the propulsion system start/stop device is in a position that allows operation of the propulsion system.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: engage and disengage reverse gear with the ignition in each position and check the lamp state.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the propulsion system cannot operate.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: disengage reverse gear or switch off the propulsion system and verify that the lamp turns OFF.

requirements.text: The stop lamp (category S1 or S2) shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that a valid R148 (or R7) approval mark for the stop lamp function is on the lamp.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles, the point on the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis that is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outer edge of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 stop lamp shall be installed not less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground according to para 5.8.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 stop lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 stop lamp shall provide geometric visibility of 45° to the left and to the right of the vehicle's longitudinal axis horizontally, and 15° above and below the horizontal vertically; if the lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane and the downward angle to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify the unobstructed view of the stop lamp apparent surface over the specified angles in the installed condition.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check that the stop lamp reference axis points rearwards when installed.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the service brake and verify that all stop lamps light simultaneously.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamps are used to give the emergency stop signal, all lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking signal and measure the flash frequency and phase of the stop lamps.

requirements.text: The two rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that a valid R148 (or R7) approval mark for the rear position lamp function is on the lamp.

requirements.text: The point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis that is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outer edge of the rear position lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be installed not less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the rear position lamp apparent surface height above ground according to para 5.8.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall provide geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards horizontally, and 15° above and below the horizontal vertically; if the lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane and the downward angle to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify the unobstructed view of the rear position lamp apparent surface over the specified angles in the installed condition.

requirements.text: In case the M1 vehicle is fitted with a rear side-marker lamp and the manufacturer chooses the alternative, the rear position lamp shall provide geometric visibility of 45° outwards to 45° inwards horizontally (inward angle reducible to 20° under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm), and 15° above and below the horizontal vertically (downward angle reducible to 5° if mounted below 750 mm).
requirements.test_case: Verify the visibility of the apparent surface over the alternative angles with a rear side-marker lamp fitted.

requirements.text: In case the alternative geometric visibility of para 6.10.5.2 is used, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of at least 12.5 cm² of its apparent surface to be considered visible, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected unobstructed apparent surface area of the rear position lamp at the boundary angles, excluding the retro-reflector area.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check that the rear position lamp reference axis points rearwards when installed.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Functional test of the rear position lamp switching with the vehicle lighting controls.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be type-approved as a Class IA or IB retro-reflector according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check that a valid R150 (or R3) Class IA or IB approval mark is on the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector that is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outer edge of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be installed not less than 250 mm and not more than 900 mm above the ground, or not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp, or not more than 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the retro-reflector illuminating surface above ground on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall provide geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards horizontally, and 10° above and below the horizontal vertically; if the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm, the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify the unobstructed view of the retro-reflector illuminating surface over the specified angles in the installed condition.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check that the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards when installed.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is arranged as in the Annex 3 Part 7 example where the non-textured outer lens is excluded and surface "7b" is declared as the apparent surface of function F2 according to paragraph 2.10.2, the part of function F1 lying in front of F2 shall not be transparent to the light of F2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the drawing and the sample, and energise F2 alone, to confirm that no F2 light passes through the F1 area used to declare apparent surface 7b.

requirements.text: For the visibility check of para 5.10 (no white light visible to the rear except permitted functions), white light from the lamp other than the reversing lamp, such as stray or leaked white LED light, shall not be directly visible to an observer's eye in rear zone 2. Zone 2 is bounded in height by horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. It is bounded in width by vertical planes at 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, passing through the rearmost point(s) of contact of the planes delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed and each non-reversing function lit, check visually or by sight-line analysis from points in zone 2 that no white light other than the reversing lamp is directly visible.

requirements.text: In conformity of production checks, the measured position of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector on the vehicle in width, height and length shall fulfil the individual specifications applicable to each lamp, checked against paragraphs 2.10.2, 2.10.3, 2.10.4, 2.3.3 and 5.4.
requirements.test_case: Measure the width, height and length positions of each function's apparent surface on a production vehicle and compare them with paras 6.4.4, 6.7.4, 6.10.4 and 6.14.4.

requirements.text: In conformity of production checks, the measured angles of geometric visibility of each lamp function shall fulfil the individual specifications applicable to that lamp; the angle limits may be relaxed by an allowance corresponding to the ±3° mounting variation permitted in paragraph 5.3.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, check the visibility of each function's apparent surface at the prescribed horizontal and vertical limit angles, allowing ±3°.

requirements.text: The red light of the rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be visible towards the front, and the white light of the reversing lamp shall only be visible towards the rear as permitted by paragraph 5.10.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the production vehicle from the front zone and the rear zone defined in para 5.10 and Annex 4 for any non-permitted red or white light.

requirements.text: When switched on through the vehicle electrical system, the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp and their tell-tales shall function in accordance with paragraphs 5.11 to 5.14 and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Switch on each function on a production vehicle and verify the correct activation, electrical connection logic and tell-tale operation.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of the lamps and their markings shall meet paragraphs 5.15 and 5.16 and the individual specifications for each lamp: red for the rear position lamp, stop lamp and retro-reflector, and white for the reversing lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the installed lamps and their approval markings for presence, number, colour, arrangement and category.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of UN R48 (paragraphs 6.4, 6.7, 6.10 and 6.14).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and count the installed lamps per function against the numbers required in paragraphs 6.4, 6.7, 6.10 and 6.14.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system marked 'Y' mounted completely on a movable component, the system shall meet all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component (paragraph 5.18.1).
requirements.test_case: Measure position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the installed system with the movable component in each fixed position.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system mounted completely on a movable component and additional lamps are switched ON in any fixed open position, those additional lamps shall satisfy all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Open the movable component to each fixed position and verify that the additional lamps meet position, visibility, colour and photometric requirements.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system mounted partly on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant during device approval shall meet all position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.test_case: Check the specified interdependent lamps on the vehicle for position, outward visibility, colour and photometry at every fixed position of the movable component.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system mounted partly on a fixed and partly on a movable component, the specified interdependent lamp(s) shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the device approval at all fixed positions of the movable component(s), so that the inwards geometric visibility is deemed satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric measurement of the specified lamps across the approval light distribution field with the movable component in each fixed position.

requirements.text: In case the lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, the replacement function shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a rear position lamp failure and measure the colour, intensity and position of the replacement function.

requirements.text: In case of a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: With the replacement active, operate the replacement device's original function (e.g. stop lamp) and verify it still meets its requirements.

requirements.text: During a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard shall indicate the occurrence of the temporary replacement and the need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Induce a rear position lamp failure and verify that the dashboard tell-tale is activated.

requirements.text: On an M1 vehicle, one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second reversing lamp device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and count the reversing lamps fitted (1 mandatory, max. 2).

requirements.text: Two stop lamp devices of category S1 or S2 shall be installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm that exactly two S1/S2 stop lamps are fitted, one in each rear combination lamp.

requirements.text: If the component regulation requires it, a tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure of the reversing lamp LEDs and check that the failure tell-tale activates where R148 requires it.

requirements.text: If the component regulation requires it, a tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp shall be provided.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure of the stop lamp LEDs and check that the failure tell-tale activates where R148 requires it.

requirements.text: If the component regulation requires it, a tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be provided.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure of the rear position lamp LEDs and check that the failure tell-tale activates where R148 requires it.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop lamps fitted.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal and verify that all stop lamps flash simultaneously.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with the other lamp functions both on and off, and verify the stop lamp flashing is unaffected.

requirements.text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5 and 6, so production rear combination lamps fitted to the vehicle must keep the installation-relevant characteristics (visibility, orientation, colour, intensity) of the approved type.
requirements.test_case: Perform Annex 9 CoP checks (visibility of lamps, light intensities) on production vehicles fitted with series lamps and compare them with the approved type.
